proposed_scope: One new raised-wheel, zero-motion X1 emergency-input electrical/status pretest using the repaired qualification ELF. No target, RPDO or controlword. Hold the normally-open latching X1 input active for about three seconds, reset it, observe at least five seconds with no motion, and require both packed statusword halves to show bit 15 inactive-active-inactive while all velocity feedback stays zero. Final drive power OFF and can0 DOWN; no automatic retry.
